source.label: Period alignment (modern conduct framework — SweetAstro adaptation of the KAT/BNN alignment principle)
source.basis: Align daily conduct with the nature of the running Mahadasha/Antardasha/Pratyantardasha lord; work the obstructing planet instead of dismissing it.

safety_rules: Optional conduct guidance only; never a guarantee, prescription, or classical authority.
No cost, purchase, ritual or object is required by this module.
Traditional anchors (weekday service/mantra) are optional supports, never requirements.
Never drop the engine's non-certainty language when presenting this alignment.

Sun.focus: lead with integrity: accountable roles, kept commitments, steady morning discipline, respect for mentors and father figures
Sun.avoid: ego clashes, credit-grabbing, display over duty

Moon.focus: stabilise mind and routine: sleep hygiene, emotional steadiness, care for mother and home

Mars.focus: channel energy into disciplined effort: exercise, courage on hard tasks, finishing pending work

Mercury.focus: study and communicate clearly: keep accounts and notes, verify before acting, honest speech

Jupiter.focus: learn and guide ethically: gratitude to teachers, moderation, counsel that is asked for

Venus.focus: cultivate respectful relationships and balance: cleanliness, fair agreements, arts in proportion

Saturn.focus: persevere and own responsibility: service to elders and workers, punctuality, patient long-horizon work
Saturn.domains: career discipline, longevity, service, maturing delays

Rahu.focus: keep rules transparent: digital discipline, structured experimentation, service without display

Ketu.focus: deep focused work: meditation, minimalism, finishing what is started
Ketu.avoid: abandoning mid-way, escapism, detachment from duties
Ketu.domains: insight, moksha, research, releasing what is outgrown
